title: Data Retention
ilmEnabled_tooltip: Index Lifecycle Management automatically moves data between tiers as it ages, optimizing storage cost. Disable only if you manage data movement manually.
hotDays_tooltip: Days to keep data in the hot tier. Hot data is actively indexed and frequently queried — stored on fast SAN (PowerStore). Memory:Storage ratio 1:30.
warmDays_tooltip: Days to keep data in the warm tier after leaving hot. Read-only data with occasional queries. Lower memory ratio (1:160) reduces node count vs hot tier.
coldDays_tooltip: Days to keep data in the cold tier. Rarely queried data for compliance. Very low memory ratio (1:500). Set to 0 to skip this tier.
frozenDays_tooltip: Days to keep data in the frozen tier as searchable snapshots on object storage (PowerScale/ECS). Lowest cost at 1:1600 ratio. Set to 0 to skip this tier.
